name: Simple.css (translated)
description: Simple.css's classless look on the t-* vocabulary: flat surfaces, 1px borders everywhere, one solid-accent button, zebra tables, boxed details/pre/notice, uniform 5px radius, no shadows. Deliberately more austere than the pico skin.
notes: Translated, not vendored: Simple styles bare elements page-wide (body document grid, 3rem h1, every <button> accent-filled, every <td> bordered), which cannot be aliased onto tailor markup without breaking core/layout.css. Its 12 variables are bridged as private --s-* helpers (--s-bg → --t-canvas, --s-accent-bg → --t-inset, --s-accent → --t-accent-solid, --s-disabled → --t-selection …). Simple has no tabs, badges, toasts, menus, sidebar, switch or status colours; those are composed in its idiom (bordered pills, accent-bg boxes, a 3px tone bar on notices/toasts/toned rows).
